Fields.Name: Iron Attack SFX [1]
Fields.Description: HitEffectSfxParam row played when an attack with Attack Material Iron hits this material. Both [1] and [2] play. The attack's Hit SFX Direction (0–4) is added to the row ID when that row exists; otherwise this row is used. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Iron Attack SFX [2]
Fields.Description: Second HitEffectSfxParam row played for an Iron attack, alongside [1]. The attack's Hit SFX Direction (0–4) is added to the row ID when that row exists. 0: none.
